EIPS-tracked element introduced by an adduct

Source: R/adduct_eips_elements.R
adduct_introduced_eips_element.Rd

Maps an adduct name (as in default_adducts()$name) to the elemental isotope-pattern (EIPS) element it adds to the ion, if any. EIPS tracks N, O, S, Cl and Br; only adducts that carry one of these into the ion have an entry.

In the current default_adducts() table [M+Cl]- is the only such adduct (H, Na, K and NH4 add none of the tracked elements), so a 35Cl/37Cl isotope pattern on a feature annotated as [M+Cl]- is explained by the adduct itself and is not evidence that the neutral molecule contains chlorine. This is a fixed internal lookup for the default adduct table, not a formula parser.

Usage

adduct_introduced_eips_element(adduct)

Arguments

adduct

Character vector of adduct names.

Value

Character vector the same length as adduct: the introduced element, or NA_character_ where the adduct introduces none.
